## Context
The generated configuration narrative says resolved configuration is exposed through an MCP configuration-transparency surface. Its adjacent heading also labels the topic as `MCP/CLI exposure`, although no MCP configuration tool exists. Both assertions originated in the accepted generator design on `consensual-ignored-ivorygull`.

## Plan
- In `scripts/gen_config_reference.py`, change the `Exposure (MCP/CLI exposure)` heading to `Exposure (CLI exposure)` and remove the `MCP config-transparency surface` clause so the paragraph describes only the implemented `rebar config` CLI view.
- Retain accurate `rebar config` CLI exposure guidance.
- Regenerate `docs/config-reference.md` and prove it is current with `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check`.
- In `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py`, rename the `REQUIRED_TOPICS` label from `mcp/cli exposure` to `cli exposure` while retaining positive coverage of the implemented CLI guidance.
- In `tests/unit/test_gen_config_reference.py`, add an explicit negative assertion over the rendered configuration narrative that rejects each unsupported form: `MCP/CLI exposure`, `MCP config-transparency surface`, and `MCP configuration surface`.
- Do not add an MCP tool or change configuration behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The generated heading is `Exposure (CLI exposure)` and the paragraph contains no MCP configuration-surface claim.
- [x] Implemented CLI configuration inspection remains documented accurately.
- [x] `python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check` proves `docs/config-reference.md` is current after regeneration.
- [x] Focused generator tests include the enumerated negative guard and fail on restoration of any removed MCP-exposure wording.
- [x] Configuration runtime and MCP tool inventory are unchanged.
